Created [ARC-001 architecture and readiness matrix](/tmp/dfai-architecture-eval-g_qmwtbn/project/docs/specs/arc/ARC-001.md).

- **Ready for epic planning:** FR-002 booking and FR-003 roster.
- **Blocked:** FR-001 sign-in, pending identity-provider and enrollment decisions documented in [ADR-001](/tmp/dfai-architecture-eval-g_qmwtbn/project/docs/specs/adr/ADR-001.md).
- **Cross-cutting constraints defined:** session revocation, phone privacy, and hosted operation.

Booking and roster delivery still depend on working sign-in. Document checks passed; runtime tests were not run because no implementation exists. The approved PRD and policy remain unchanged.
